tool:bla.name: bla
tool:bla.description: Ferramentas de defesa baseadas no projeto [qybaihe/bla](https://github.com/qybaihe/bla).
usage_examples: npm install -g bla-agents

# Aplicar todas as defesas
bla harden ./build/

# Técnicas específicas
bla harden ./build/ --techniques exhaustion,poison,deception
bla harden ./build/ --scope logic,interfaces,metadata

# Red team validation
npx bla-agents validate ./build/ --redteam

# Benchmark resistência
bla benchmark ./build/
